name: button-hover-right
title: Expanding Icon Button
description: A circular blue button that shows only a white arrow. Hovering widens it into a pill that reveals the word Visit beside the arrow, and leaving shrinks it back.
use: Space is tight and a single clear action can start as an icon and reveal its label on hover.
avoid: Hover is the only way to see the label, so touch and keyboard users only ever get the arrow.
a11y: The button is focusable and the word Visit stays in the DOM, but the label only becomes visible on hover, never on focus. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small round button in a navy-to-indigo gradient with a pale blue outline and a white right arrow centred. Expanded, it becomes a wide pill holding white Visit text with the arrow at its right end.
behaves: On hover the circle stretches sideways into a pill while Visit fades and slides into view; the arrow stays pinned to the right. Leaving shrinks it back to a circle and fades the label out.
customise: The label, gradient, border and arrow are hardcoded; it takes no props, so text and colours need a file edit.
weight: light: One button with a CSS width and opacity transition, no JavaScript.
